name: Worldz Fair Fee Builder™
publicRule: Worldz starts new creator launches at 1.00% where the selected venue can implement that fee accurately. Worldz public launch settings never expose a project trading fee above 3.00%. Use 0.25% increments where that maps truthfully to the chain or venue; otherwise show the venue's real discrete tiers or native market model.

magicFeeNumber75Bps.rule: Preserved where existing REVIVE/MagicFeeNumber proof or an adapter explicitly depends on it. It is not the default for new WorldzLaunchPad intakes.

solana.venueRule: Worldz project-fee selection is separate from Raydium/Meteora protocol deductions. An adapter must prove the exact venue fee and recipient split before mainnet.

worldzCurve.reason: Current reviewed Raydium LaunchLab Devnet config requires its proven 2.00% profile; do not pretend the generic 1% choice is executable on this route yet.

amm.rule: XRPL AMM TradingFee cannot exceed 1%. Worldz deliberately presents four simple choices instead of exposing unnecessary fine-grained complexity.
amm.note: XRPL protocol supports 0.001% fee precision and a 1% maximum. Worldz uses 0.25% public UI steps for simplicity, not because the protocol requires that step.

clob.rule: XRPL native order-book Offers do not use an AMM trading-fee slider. Show price/spread, network transaction cost and any separately disclosed Worldz service/accounting route.

ethereum.venueRule: The Worldz project-fee target and the selected AMM's native fee tier are separate. Never invent a 0.25% tier if the chosen DEX exposes only discrete tiers.

base.venueRule: The Worldz project-fee target and the selected AMM's native fee tier are separate.

bnb.venueRule: Use only the exact fee capabilities proven for the selected BNB venue.

hyperevm.venueRule: HyperEVM fee routing and any HyperCore market integration remain distinct. Do not pretend an EVM token fee controls HyperCore order-book fees.

robinhood.venueRule: Use only chain/venue fee controls independently proven for Robinhood Chain.

cetusCLMM.rule: Worldz only exposes real Cetus tiers and filters out 4% because it exceeds the Worldz 3% public cap. It does not fabricate 0.25-step tiers the venue does not support.

deepBook.rule: Order-book fees are venue-native and disclosed separately.

bitcoin.rule: Native Bitcoin does not receive a fake token transfer tax. Marketplace, bridge, wrapping and execution fees are provider/venue-specific and disclosed separately.

preSignatureDisclosure: actual native venue fee or tier
